meaning:
ἐμ-πλέκω
[in LXX: Pro.28:18 (נָפַל), 2Ma.15:17 * ;]
to weave in, entwine; pass., metaphorically, to be involved, entangled in: 2Ti.2:4, 2Pe.2:20.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: No soldier on duty entangles himself in the affairs of life, that he may please him who enrolled him as a soldier.
For if, after they have escaped the defilement of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they are again entangled in it and…
